# `main.aug`

## HTTP configuration

Listen on `127.0.0.1`. Limit request bodies to 16384 bytes and buffered responses to 1048576 bytes. Serve OpenAPI at `/openapi.json` and API docs at `/docs`.

## Startup

It tries to call [`initializeKeys`](common/keys.aug.md#symbol-initializeKeys) using `Crypto` for `crypto`, `SigningKeys` for `keys`. If this attempt raises `CryptoError`, it catches it as `error` and calls `print` (`value` set to `"Cryptographic initialization failed"`); then it calls `exit` (`status` set to `1`). If this attempt raises [`KeyError`](common/keys.aug.md#symbol-KeyError), it catches it as `error` and calls `print` (`value` set to `"Signing keys could not be initialized"`); then it calls `exit` (`status` set to `1`).

It serves [`home`](client/endpoints.aug.md#symbol-home), [`me`](client/endpoints.aug.md#symbol-me), [`logout`](client/logout.aug.md#symbol-logout), [`startLogin`](client/login.aug.md#symbol-startLogin), [`loginCallback`](client/login.aug.md#symbol-loginCallback), [`discovery`](provider/discovery.aug.md#symbol-discovery), [`jwks`](provider/discovery.aug.md#symbol-jwks), [`authorize`](provider/authorization.aug.md#symbol-authorize), [`providerLogin`](provider/authorization.aug.md#symbol-providerLogin), [`token`](provider/token.aug.md#symbol-token), and [`userinfo`](provider/userinfo.aug.md#symbol-userinfo) on port `8787`.

Dependency injection supplies `crypto` as [`Crypto`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto), `clock` as [`Clock`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock), `keys` as [`SigningKeys`](common/keys.aug.md#symbol-SigningKeys), `codes` as [`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationCode>`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore), and `access` as [`ExpiringStore<AccessGrant>`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore). It can use [`crypto.sha256`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.sha256), [`crypto.equal`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal), [`crypto.random`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random), [`crypto.signRsa`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.signRsa), [`clock.now`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now), [`keys.provider`](common/keys.aug.md#symbol-SigningKeys.provider), [`codes.take`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.take), and [`access.put`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put). It can fail with `CryptoError`, `TimeError`, `KeyError`, `JwtError`, `StoreFull`, and `HttpError`.

[`userinfo`](provider/userinfo.aug.md#symbol-userinfo) from `provider` takes `authorization` as `optional string` from HTTP header (omitted means null). It returns `HttpResponse<Json>`. Dependency injection supplies `clock` as [`Clock`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock) and `access` as [`ExpiringStore<AccessGrant>`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore). It can use [`clock.now`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now) and [`access.get`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.get). It can fail with `TimeError` and `HttpError`.

## Built-ins · [reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs)

`exit`: Exit from main with a status from 0 to 255 after cancellation and cleanup. `print`: Composition and test output. Other callables receive Console and declare uses console.write.
